latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — easily add AI-generated, burned-in subtitles to your videos with no manual editing.

- Upload a video and describe your desired result; automatic subtitle generation and syncing.
- Supports quick workflows: 30-60 seconds from upload to downloadable 1080p MP4.
- No local software needed; everything runs on cloud GPUs.
- Handles video uploads, subtitles, aspect ratio, and format exports via chat commands.
- Free usage includes 100 credits (7 days) with anonymous sign-in—no registration needed.
